SCOPEThis standard specifies the dimensions, material and other requirements for equal tee-body made from bar stock for use in oil-hydraulic systems.2. REFERENCESThe standards listed below contain provisions which, through reference in this text constitute provisions of this standard at the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid.
